prompt_text: Which residential pest control companies are the most reputable in the Northeast US (New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania)?

- **Anchor Pest Control**: Based in Newark, NJ, they have a 5.0-star rating from 3,638 reviews and are known for their 24/7 availability. ([contractorsranked.com](https://www.contractorsranked.com/pest-control/newark-nj?utm_source=openai))

- **All Platinum Termite & Pest Control**: Operating in Jersey City, NJ, they hold a 4.9-star rating from 592 reviews and offer round-the-clock services. ([67leads.com](https://67leads.com/top-rated-businesses/pest-control/nj?utm_source=openai))

**Pennsylvania:**

- **Cooper Pest Solutions**: Serving parts of New Jersey and Pennsylvania, they offer a range of pest control services and have been in operation since 1955. ([cooperpest.com](https://www.cooperpest.com/?utm_source=openai))

- **Rest Easy Pest Control**: Operating in New York, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania since 2012, they have a 4.9-star rating from over 2,500 Google reviews. ([resteasypestcontrol.com](https://resteasypestcontrol.com/?utm_source=openai))
